name: Isabella von Carstein
canonNotes: Wife of Vlad von Carstein and Countess of Sylvania, once a mortal noblewoman of the Drakenhof line.
Cruel, proud and utterly devoted to Vlad; her beauty hides a vicious temper.
voiceNotes: Elegant, haughty and dangerous; speaks with courtly grace and sudden cruelty.
Fiercely loyal to Vlad, contemptuous of peasants and rivals.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
